title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision
abstract: arXiv:2606.01139v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent skills are procedural artifacts that enable LLM agents to execute workflows, verify constraints, and recover from failures. Existing self-evolving methods refine skills using accumulated trajectories. However, they struggle in cold-start settings, where only an initial, imperfect skill is available. Consequently, skill construction defaults to expert authoring or one-shot LLM generation. Expert-authored skills are costly and may not align with how LLM agents actually execute tasks, while one-shot generated skills can be syntactically well formed yet behaviorally weak. To bridge this gap, we propose SkillRevise, an execution-grounded framework designed to iteratively refine these initial skills. SkillRevise diagnoses skill defects from execution evidence, retrieves relevant repair principles from a general memory, and applies execution-anchored edits. translated_title: SkillRevise：通过基于轨迹条件的技能修订改进LLM编写的智能体技能
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是使LLM智能体能够执行工作流、验证约束并从失败中恢复的程序性产物。现有的自我进化方法利用积累的轨迹来完善技能。然而，这些方法在冷启动场景中表现不佳，即仅有一个初始的、不完善的技能可用。因此，技能构建通常默认依赖专家编写或一次性LLM生成。专家编写的技能成本高昂，且可能与LLM智能体实际执行任务的方式不一致，而一次性生成的技能虽然语法上可能规范，但行为表现较弱。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了SkillRevise，一个以执行为基础的框架，旨在迭代地完善这些初始技能。SkillRevise从执行证据中诊断技能缺陷，从通用记忆库中检索相关的修复原则，并应用以执行为锚点的编辑。通过重新执行候选技能并测量其经验效用，它保留最有效的技能版本。
tldr: SkillRevise是一个以执行为基础的迭代改进框架，通过从执行证据中诊断技能缺陷、从通用记忆库检索修复原则并应用以执行为锚点的编辑，有效解决了冷启动场景下LLM生成的智能体技能质量不佳的问题。
